source: OpenSSL 3.5.7 (9 Jun 2026), SM2 key pair generated by OpenSSL itself
how: openssl genpkey -algorithm SM2 -out sm2.key; openssl pkeyutl -sign -inkey sm2.key -rawin -digest sm3 -pkeyopt distid:1234567812345678 -in msg.bin -out sig.der
note: TEST-ONLY interop fixture. Stores a PUBLIC key and a SIGNATURE over a PUBLIC message. No private key is stored, and this key pair is never used by any service, configuration or runtime path.
